title: How agents are transforming work
candidate_claim: OpenAI reports a shift in its Codex data toward longer-horizon and parallel agent work, including non-engineering use.
notes: Provider research; its estimates and populations are bounded and should not be generalized.

title: The Anthropic Economic Index report: New building blocks for understanding AI use
candidate_claim: Anthropic's November 2025 sample distinguishes collaboration from directive delegation and reports both movement and reversal in that measure.
notes: Provider-generated analysis of sampled conversations; it is not a labour-market survey.

title: OpenClaw install and managed startup documentation
candidate_claim: OpenClaw documents managed startup and gateway operation across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
notes: Demonstrates offered infrastructure, not how many people use it or whether they run it continuously.

title: OpenClaw lore
candidate_claim: OpenClaw identifies its predecessor Clawd as active from 25 November 2025 to 27 January 2026.
notes: Project-authored chronology; it does not prove a wider turning point.

title: Workflows for work that runs the business
candidate_claim: Mistral describes durable, observable, human-approval-capable enterprise workflows and named customers using them.
notes: EU-provider product account; customer use and impact need independent checking.

title: Alibaba launches Wukong: an AI-native agentic platform for enterprises
candidate_claim: Alibaba describes Wukong as an agentic platform embedded in DingTalk and enterprise workflows.
notes: China-centre product source; it does not establish use or effect outside its stated environment.

title: The rapid embrace of AI in China, its biggest testing ground, may shape how AI is used globally
candidate_claim: AP reports examples of OpenClaw and agentic AI use in China, including one student's study and internship use.
notes: Use as a signal and reported experience, not as evidence of prevalence or national impact.

title: Making Claude Cowork ready for enterprise
candidate_claim: Anthropic describes organisation controls and audit events for Cowork actions, files, skills, and approvals.
notes: A provider account of available features, not proof that controls are sufficient or broadly used.
